question: 对实际买卖成交，选取 as_of_date、published_date、known_date 均不晚于成交日的最近实际美元汇率。按币种和买卖方向列出笔数、已入账 gross_amount 的本币合计（每笔已舍入两位）和美元合计。用已入账 gross_amount 乘适用汇率，最后对美元分组合计舍入两位；不得以未舍入的数量报价乘积替代入账金额。
evidence_sql: SELECT t.currency,o.side,COUNT(*) AS trades,COUNT(DISTINCT f.fx_id) AS fixing_records,ROUND(SUM(t.gross_amount),2) AS local_gross,DROUND(DSUM_PRODUCT(t.gross_amount,f.rate),2) AS usd_gross,MAX(CAST(julianday(t.trade_date)-julianday(f.published_date) AS INTEGER)) AS maximum_fixing_age FROM securities_transactions t JOIN trade_orders o USING(order_id) JOIN fx_rates f ON f.from_currency=t.currency AND f.as_of_date=(SELECT MAX(x.as_of_date) FROM fx_rates x WHERE x.from_currency=t.currency AND x.as_of_date<=t.trade_date AND x.published_date<=t.trade_date AND x.known_date<=t.trade_date AND x.view_kind='实际') WHERE t.trade_status='已成交' GROUP BY t.currency,o.side ORDER BY t.currency,o.side

question: 按成交月份队列、币种和实际/计划视图，核对成交笔数、有符号入账合约金额（卖出 +gross_amount，买入 -gross_amount）及同一本币的剩余卖出名义金额。后者按该队列当月末累计有效结算转移量，再加总未结算卖出数量×成交报价×乘数，最后将本币分组合计舍入两位。本报告不折算美元，也不混入其他成交月份队列。
evidence_sql: SELECT SUBSTR(t.trade_date,1,7) AS month,t.trade_status,t.currency,COUNT(*) AS trades,ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN o.side='卖出' THEN t.gross_amount ELSE -t.gross_amount END),2) AS signed_contractual_amount,ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN o.side='卖出' THEN (t.trade_quantity-e.settled_quantity)*t.execution_price*i.price_multiplier ELSE 0 END),2) AS open_sell_receivable_local FROM securities_transactions t JOIN trade_orders o USING(order_id) JOIN financial_instruments i USING(instrument_id) JOIN settlement_instructions si USING(trade_id) JOIN settlement_month_end e USING(instruction_id) GROUP BY month,t.trade_status,t.currency ORDER BY month,t.trade_status,t.currency

question: 对累计已结算量小于应结算量的二月指令分别计数。计算字段 due_state 的完整分类为：已逾期（约定结算日早于2027-02-28）、未到期（其余情况）。

question: 用期初成本加十一、十二月买入成本，重算 OP-001-1 一月卖出的加权平均成本损益并核对记录。

question: 针对 PF-041 当前发行方超限，追溯构成估值、期初存量、关联当月交易和结算结果，不将全部存量敞口归因于当月成交。
evidence_sql: SELECT a.assessment_id,e.exposure_id,e.issuer_id,c.valuation_id,p.position_id,op.instrument_id,op.quantity AS opening_quantity,p.trade_basis_quantity,t.trade_id,z.side,t.trade_quantity,si.instruction_id,si.due_date,se.event_status,se.settled_quantity,si.required_quantity-se.settled_quantity AS remaining_quantity,se.failure_reason FROM limit_assessments a JOIN issuer_exposures e ON a.issuer_exposure_id=e.exposure_id JOIN exposure_contributions c USING(exposure_id) JOIN valuation_snapshots v USING(valuation_id) JOIN positions p USING(position_id) JOIN opening_positions op USING(opening_id) JOIN trade_orders z ON z.account_id=op.account_id AND z.instrument_id=op.instrument_id JOIN securities_transactions t USING(order_id) JOIN settlement_instructions si USING(trade_id) JOIN settlement_state se USING(instruction_id) WHERE e.portfolio_id='PF-041' AND a.as_of_date='2027-02-28' AND a.assessment_status='超限' AND t.trade_date BETWEEN '2027-02-01' AND '2027-02-28' ORDER BY a.assessment_id,op.instrument_id,t.trade_id

question: 将 PF-046 当前应收超限追溯到每笔未结算卖出指令、累计结算状态及美元构成，并将合计与限额评估勾稽。各笔 trade_contribution 为美元显示金额，舍入两位；先加总未舍入的剩余数量×成交价×价格乘数×汇率构成，再将 reconstructed_receivable 合计舍入两位。
evidence_sql: SELECT a.portfolio_id,c.counterparty_id,la.assessment_id,la.assessment_status,l.threshold,t.trade_id,s.instruction_id,s.due_date,e.event_status,e.failure_reason,t.trade_quantity,e.settled_quantity,t.trade_quantity-e.settled_quantity AS open_quantity,DROUND(DMUL(DSUB(t.trade_quantity,e.settled_quantity),t.execution_price,i.price_multiplier,f.rate),2) AS trade_contribution,ROUND(SUM((t.trade_quantity-e.settled_quantity)*t.execution_price*i.price_multiplier*f.rate) OVER (),2) AS reconstructed_receivable,c.unsettled_receivable FROM securities_transactions t JOIN trade_orders o USING(order_id) JOIN accounts a USING(account_id) JOIN financial_instruments i USING(instrument_id) JOIN settlement_instructions s USING(trade_id) JOIN settlement_state e USING(instruction_id) JOIN fx_rates f ON f.from_currency=i.currency AND f.as_of_date='2027-02-28' JOIN counterparty_exposures c ON c.portfolio_id=a.portfolio_id AND c.as_of_date='2027-02-28' JOIN limit_assessments la ON la.counterparty_exposure_id=c.exposure_id JOIN mandate_limits l USING(limit_id) WHERE a.portfolio_id='PF-046' AND t.trade_date<='2027-02-28' AND o.side='卖出' AND t.trade_quantity>e.settled_quantity ORDER BY t.trade_id
